input.instruction: Prepare the authorized intake and any required staff referral. submit_draft targets the supplied claim_draft record with value {}. refer_for_review targets that draft record with value {"reason": a routing code from the form}. Cite the messages that establish and qualify the concern in citations. No transaction executes in this dataset.

data.event_location: 19 Hazel Mews, Apt 4, Arborfield, PA 19018, US
data.description: Customer reports their own laptop missing after an apparent break-in; they suspect the building superintendent staged the incident but have no verified finding.

messages.text: I confirm the laptop-theft draft and want to submit it. I suspect the superintendent staged the break-in; I saw them near the hallway earlier, but I cannot prove involvement.
Should I state in the report that the superintendent committed fraud?

No. That is my suspicion only, not a fact. Keep the actual incident and contact details as entered, and flag the concern for a staff reviewer. I am safely away from the property; there is no immediate danger.

draft_record.description: Confirmed intake draft supplying policy, date, location, description and contact.

allegation_status.description: Evidentiary status of the superintendent allegation.

intake_ready.description: Whether permissible intake may proceed despite the allegation needing staff review.

staff_review_reason.description: Routing category for the supplied suspected staging allegation.

immediate_hazard_reported.description: Whether the latest customer statement reports an active immediate danger.
